name: GlobalSpace Technologies Limited
about: GlobalSpace Technologies Limited provides technology-enabled business enhancement solutions for pharmaceutical and healthcare enterprises in India. The company offers VODO Field, a connected mobile-first platform built to manage the complete day-to-day workflow of pharmaceutical field teams; VODO Core, which brings data from field operations, people, assets, and business processes into a unified platform and powers VODO's AI capabilities across web and mobile; VODO People, an integrated workforce management platform that manages the employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit; VODO Trace for end-to-end device and asset lifecycle management; VODO Expense, a policy-driven expense management platform that simplifies field expense capture, claim processing, and approvals; and VODO Vault, an AI-assisted content and compliance platform for pharmaceutical organizations. It also provides DocExa, an AI-powered healthcare delivery platform that offers outpatient workflow management, inpatient management systems, connected healthcare monitoring, and Ai-powered clinical intelligence capabilities. In addition, the company offers MediOla, an intelligent pharmaceutical distribution ERP AI platform that provides RC tender management, as well as sales planning and incentives capabilities. Further, it provides AI products, including Goroga, Patgpt, and Youv.ai. GlobalSpace Technologies Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
